case.title: Pilot's Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge, FAA-H-8083-25C
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF, pinned by byte count and SHA-256. The official FAA publisher URL is retained for reproducibility.
case.rightsBasis: U.S. Government publication, retained as an external development corpus source. The PDF is not bundled or relicensed under the library license.
case.reviewStatus: Initial inspection points only; no independently annotated full-book fidelity reference yet.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS arm64 release CLI, library defaults; initial regression ceiling, not an iOS memory guarantee

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Two-column prose interleaves left and right lines; left paragraph ending must be defined. should precede The computation of density altitude.
Whole-page fallback has excessive white margins and undersized content.
Two-column glossary interleaves Wind direction indicators. and Zone of confusion. before Wind shear.

rightsClearance.scope: Commercial use and redistribution of the development corpus; retain applicable license attribution.

case.downloadVerification: A fresh download through Tools/fetch_corpus.py matches the owner-supplied identity; see measurements/corpus-downloads/verification.json.

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
